consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: Davco® K10 Rapid is designed to be applied to substrates in a minimum 2 coat application to acheive a 1mm dry film thickness.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: Each coat shall be applied at a minimum thickness 0.75mm per coat at wet film thickness.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: Apply additional coats to acheive the minimum 1mm dry film requirements.

consumption.label: Consumption
consumption.text: A 15Ltr pail will cover approximately 10m2 with 2 coats.

coats.label: Consumption
coats.text: Davco® K10 Rapid is designed to be applied to substrates in a minimum 2 coat application to acheive a 1mm dry film thickness.

coats.label: Consumption
coats.text: A 15Ltr pail will cover approximately 10m2 with 2 coats.

cure_times.label: Applied Product Ready for Use
cure_times.text: Allow membrane to dry for 3-4 hours at 22°C and 50% relative humidity prior to covering with tile or other suitable covering.

cure_times.label: Applied Product Ready for Use
cure_times.text: Should flood testing be needed please allow membrane to dry for 24 hours prior to testing.

compat.text: Davco® K10 Rapid is a flexible, rapid drying, Class III waterproofing membrane designed for internal and external applications.
compat.heading: DESCRIPTION

compat.text: concrete, cement renders, screed, lightweight blocks, prepared metal and pvc control leak flanges, building boards approved for wet areas, such as compressed fibre cement sheeting
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Areas Suitable for interior and exterior applications
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Davco® K10 Rapid can be used in conjunction with Davco K10 Plus as required.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Suitable as an anti-fracture membrane prior to tiling applications
compat.heading: CHARACTERISTICS / ADVANTAGES

compat.text: Light Weight Blocks Prime the surface with 2 coats of Davco Ultraprime or Davco PrimeX
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

compat.text: Building Boards and Sheeting Standard Wall / floor building boards must be primed with a suitable Sika Branded primer and firmly fixed in accordance to manufacturer instructions and applicable Australian Standards
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

compat.text: Compressed Fibre Cement Boards This should be primed using Davco PrimeX. Allow the primer to dry before application of the membrane.
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY

compat.text: Primer Guide Substrate Primer Porous Substrates Davco Ultraprime or Davco PrimeX Dense Concrete Davco PrimeX Metal and PVC terminations and connections Lightly sand /abrade prior to application Refer to the specific instruction for each primer on the product data sheet for additional primer application information.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Materials to avoid
storage.text: No special restrictions on storage with other products.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: For personal protection see section 8. No special handling advice required. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
